ref_text: The market opens slowly in the mornings. Shutters rattle up one by one, a radio plays somewhere behind a wall, and the first customers stand at the counter counting out their change.

lines.text: You get one chance to hear what was in that box, so remember every word.
Whatever the constable writes down is what the police will go looking for.
lines.text_kokoro: Whatever the [constable](/kˈʌnstəbəl/) writes down is what the police will go looking for.

lines.text: My box! Milk, sugar, ginger, cardamom, the cups, the strainer, the biscuits, my kettle, the spoons!
Every word she did say was about it, and that's what memory holds on to, so he wrote it down.
The kettle, the spoons, and the tea.
He brings her tea every morning, which is why there was none in the box.
Even he went looking for the tea.
If you said no, name the nine things she did say.
